art:tool:2.text:
# candystore

Append-only store for Bloodbank events. Every event is keyed by its event id (UNIQUE), so a second copy of the same event is ignored on insert.
art:tool:2.note: illustrative output; public profile cuts tool output to 280 chars

gaps.why: bb-hook leaves no record when it runs, so the trip from the CLI to hook-hub is shown from the receipt, not seen.
hook-hub keeps handler status and timing but not their output, so what each handler printed is unknown.

findings.title: codegraph-prompt never runs: binary not on hook-hub PATH
findings.detail: The sync handler codegraph-prompt exits with handler_binary_missing in 2 ms on every prompt. hook-hub runs with a PATH that has no mise shims, so the code graph never reaches the context.

findings.title: claude-notify is a broken symlink
findings.detail: The Notification handler target is a dangling symlink, so no notification can fire. No Notification hook ran in this turn, so it was found on disk, not in the run.

findings.title: traceparent is all zeros
findings.detail: The envelope carries traceparent 00-000...-00, so no trace can be joined across services. This is true of every event, not just this one.
